# Sultana Food Industry

> Maker of traditional handmade laddoo (laddu), Thank You wedding favours (door gifts for weddings / door gift kahwin), gift boxes, chilled desserts and drinks, and dessert table catering. Based in Selangor, Malaysia, with delivery across Malaysia. Orders and quotes by WhatsApp: +60 16-800 9417. Prices are quoted per order.

Languages: English and Bahasa Melayu.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://sultanafood.com/): products, wedding packages, events, promotions and how to order
- [Products](https://sultanafood.com/#products): laddoo trays, Thank You wedding favours, Signature Gift Box, Lai Chee Kang and Air Limau Jelly
- [Wedding & event packages](https://sultanafood.com/#packages): 100, 500 (most popular) and 1000 pieces, each laddoo individually packed in a Thank You pouch
- [Events & catering](https://sultanafood.com/#events): dessert tables with laddoo towers, Lai Chee Kang and chilled drinks for walimah, kenduri, weddings, corporate events, hotels, Hari Raya and Deepavali
- [Become a stockist](https://sultanafood.com/#distributor): wholesale pricing, steady supply and point-of-sale display support for shops, cafés and resellers

## Contact and ordering

- [Order on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/60168009417): send the event date, quantity and delivery area; Sultana replies with availability and a quote
- [Enquiry form](https://sultanafood.com/#contact): name, phone and what you need, sent through WhatsApp

## Products

- [Laddoo Trays](https://sultanafood.com/#products): laddoo arranged on trays for kenduri, open houses and family gatherings
- ["Thank You" Wedding Favours](https://sultanafood.com/#products): each laddoo sealed in its own floral Thank You pouch, for guests at a walimah or wedding
- [Signature Gift Box](https://sultanafood.com/#products): six premium laddoo with cashew, pistachio and silver leaf in a maroon box; for corporate gifts and Hari Raya
- [Lai Chee Kang](https://sultanafood.com/#products): chilled dessert of lychee, longan, red dates, white fungus, barley and grass jelly in light syrup
- [Air Limau Jelly](https://sultanafood.com/#products): calamansi lime drink with colourful jelly, nata de coco and selasih seeds over ice
